SENECA AREA SCHOOL DISTRICT RESOLUTION

Resolution Under Wis. Stat. § 121.91(3)(a) to Exceed the Revenue Limit and to Cause Submittal of this Resolution to the Electors on a Referendum Basis for Their Approval or Rejection

WHEREAS, the School Board of the Seneca Area School District in the Town of Seneca, Crawford County, Wisconsin has determined that it is in the best interests of the students of the District to exceed the revenue limit to meet certain facility, equipment, and programming needs of the School District; and

WHEREAS, state law has imposed a revenue limit upon the amount of monies available to a school district from state aid and the local property tax levy; and

WHEREAS, it is deemed by the School Board to be in the best interest of the taxpayers of the District to take advantage of the revenue limit exceedance authority under Wis. Stat. § 121.91, placed in local school districts under that statute; and

WHEREAS, revenue exceedances may either be for a non-recurring or a recurring purpose; and

WHEREAS, the Seneca Area School District has the need for recurring exceedance for the 2027-2028 school year and thereafter; and

WHEREAS, the need for the School Board and the electors of the School District to authorize a revenue limit exceedance is the decline in state aid, increasing operational costs, and the need to finance the provision of ongoing services; and

WHEREAS, it is deemed to be appropriate for the School District to submit to electors at the next regular fall election to be held on November 3, 2026, the question of whether the Seneca Area School District, be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91(2m), Wisconsin Statutes, by $500,000.00 in the 2027-2028 school year on a recurring basis and by an additional $470,000.00 in the 2028-2029 school year on a recurring basis for recurring purposes for paying the ongoing operational expenses of the school district.  

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED by the School Board of the Seneca Area School District that it shall include revenue in its budget for the 2027-2028 school year and thereafter on a recurring basis, a sum not to exceed $500,000.00 in excess of the revenue limits set forth in Wis. Stat. § 121.91 for the purpose of meeting operational expenses. In addition, the School Board of the Seneca Area School District shall also include revenue in its budget for the 2028-2029 school year and thereafter on a recurring basis, an additional sum not to exceed $470,000.00 in excess of the revenue limits set forth in Wis. Stat. § 121.91 for the purpose of meeting operational expenses. The total exceedance, including both the 2027-2028 school year exceedance and the 2028-2029 school year exceedance, shall result in a total sum not to exceed $970,000.00 in excess of the revenue limits set forth in Wis. Stat. § 121.91 on a recurring basis for the 2028-2029 school year and thereafter for the purpose of meeting operational expenses.  

BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that for this purpose the School Board shall add a -recurring sum for the 2027-2028 school year and thereafter in an amount not to exceed the sum of $500,000.00 over and above the revenue cap for the 2027-2028 school year and thereafter, as calculated in accord with the formula under Wis. Stat. § 121.91(2m). In addition, for this purpose the School Board shall add an additional ¬recurring sum for the 2028-2029 school year and thereafter in an amount not to exceed the sum of $470,000.00 over and above the revenue cap for the 2027-2028 school year that shall include the $500,000.00 exceedance authorized by this resolution for the 2027-2028 school year and thereafter, as calculated in accord with the formula under Wis. Stat. § 121.91(2m).

BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that the amount of excess revenue designated hereinabove, subject to approval of the electors, shall be added to the 2027-2028 and 2028-2029 school year budgets and successor school year budgets for purposes of calculating the School District revenue limit.

BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED pursuant to Wis. Stat. § 121.91(3), this Resolution shall be submitted to the electors of the School District for approval or rejection at the fall election to be held on November 3, 2026.

BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that said referendum question shall be placed on the ballot in accord with the law and that the School District Clerk shall perform all required duties in relationship thereto.

BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that this Resolution shall not be effective until ratified by the electors upon the referendum election called for in this Resolution.

BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that in accord with Wis. Stat. § 121.91(3)(a), within 10 days after the adoption hereof, the School District Clerk shall notify the Department of Public Instruction of the scheduled date of the referendum and submit a copy of this Resolution to the Department.

Adopted and recorded (August 17, 2026).

Signed by Seneca Area School Board Members: Mark Johnson, Board President, and Attest by:  Britney Joy, Board Clerk

Upon roll call vote, 7 members voted in favor of adoption of the Resolution and 0
members voted against adoption of the Resolution.
